source: 7. Profile the actual path. Nsight’s Memory Workload Analysis exposes L1, L2, and ZXNAME0000XZ bytes, hit rates, requests, and throughput. Use counters to test the model rather than treating it as proof.[3]
zh: 7. 分析实际路径。 Nsight 的内存工作负载分析公开了 L1、L2 和 ZXNAME0000XZ 字节、命中率、请求和吞吐量。使用计数器来测试模型，而不是将其视为证据。[3]
